title: Shroud of Turin knowledge base: science constants registry
precedence_note: When documents disagree: the build plan's decisions, then the v3 corrections, then the Unity PRD v2.0, then Shader of the Shroud v3, then the PoC (lessons only).

tags.measured: Direct instrument measurement or observation of the cloth or its samples.
tags.fitted: A curve or regression fitted to measurements; the fit, not the cloth, carries the number.
tags.derived: Computed from measured or fitted values by a stated formula, with no new assumption.
tags.inferred: An interpretation or model applied beyond what was measured (for example, reading h as body distance everywhere).
tags.hypothesis: A model whose parameters are unexplained or unmeasured; shown so it can be tested, not believed.
tags.contested: Published, with published disagreement that is still open.
tags.assumption: A placeholder value chosen because no measurement exists yet; replace when one does.
tags.aesthetic: A visualization or design choice, not a scientific claim.
tags.tradition: A religious or traditional claim, recorded as such.
tags.standard: An engineering or colorimetric standard (CIE, VGA timing, laser lines), not a claim about the cloth.
tags.convention: A project convention (units, axes, grid) that every engine and file follows.
tags.superseded: A number replaced by a better-sourced number; kept so old files can be traced.
tags.retracted: An earlier project claim or interpretation withdrawn by the v3 corrections or the build plan; kept as a record.
tags.unsupported: A premise the research looked for and could not support (for example, a painting that does not exist).

constants.label: Length unit
constants.note: All lengths in metres unless the unit field says otherwise.

constants.label: Axes
constants.value: Y up; flat cloth in the XZ plane; u across the width (X), v along the length (Z)

constants.label: Map grid
constants.note: One grid for every map and compute pass, about 0.54 mm per texel on the pre-2002 cloth. Shipped maps here are 512 x 2048 because the image carries no detail finer than 5 mm (see image.resolution_floor_m); tools/derive.py can bake at the full grid.

constants.label: Image field h
constants.note: h = 0 is background linen, h = 1 the most intense image point (the nose tip). Scorch may use h > 1 (same chemistry, more of it).

constants.label: Albedo from h
constants.value: albedo = lerp(LUT row at h=0, LUT row at h=1, h)
constants.note: Exact for the JJE model, which is linear in h. Rows are already adapted to D65, so an illuminant's colour lives in the row or in the light, never both.

constants.label: Frontal versus dorsal
constants.value: UV-space mask shipped with the data
constants.note: Never a view- or normal-based test. The PoC's FIXED/LEGACY toggle demonstrates why.

constants.label: Default restoration state
constants.note: The state Enrie (1931) and STURP (1978) recorded: patches and Holland backing present.

constants.label: Length before the 2002 restoration
constants.note: The PRD attributed this to the 2002 restoration and the web page to Flury-Lemberg 1998; the build plan found it is the pre-2002 size and found no Flury-Lemberg 1998 source.

constants.label: Raes sample counts (warp, weft)
constants.note: Measured on the Raes sample in 1973-74; the PRD misattributed these to Vial 1989.

constants.label: 1988 radiocarbon fragment counts (warp, weft ranges)
constants.note: The paper's own count; its quoted 38 x 25-26 comes from older work.

constants.label: Herringbone repeat (warp threads one way, then back)
Herringbone band width
constants.note: 41 / 38.3 and 39 / 38.3 warp threads per cm; one full chevron period is 80 threads = 2.09 cm.

constants.label: Band orientation
constants.value: bands run lengthwise, parallel to the warp; the twill diagonal reverses across the width
constants.note: Selvedges run along both long edges, so the warp runs lengthwise. The PRD's LinenWeave reverses along the wrong axis.

constants.label: Yarn twist
constants.note: As stated in the Unity port README.

constants.label: Flax ultimate fibre diameter
constants.note: Generic flax value from textile science, not measured on the cloth.

constants.label: Warp threads across the width (pre-2002)
constants.note: 1.11 m x 3830 per m.

constants.label: Weft picks along the length (pre-2002)
constants.note: 4.37 m x 2540 per m.

constants.label: JJE spectral model
constants.note: Fitted to the 1978 spectrophotometry (Gilbert and Gilbert 1980; Pellicori 1980). Film-independent.

constants.label: Model validity range
constants.note: The LUT baker holds lambda at the range ends outside it (380-780 nm integration).

constants.label: Image density range
constants.note: JJE's figure; the model gives 0.090 at 550 nm and 0.085 for D65 luminance.

constants.label: Reflectance ratio at h = 1 (440, 550, 680 nm)
constants.note: A wavelength-dependent multiplicative loss steepest in the blue, not added yellow.

constants.label: Chromaticity shift background to h = 1 (D65)
constants.note: Inside the overlap of the background and image clusters reported by Schwalbe and Pellicori 2023.

constants.label: Background linen, linear sRGB (D65)
constants.note: Luminance Y = 0.358.

constants.label: Maximum image (h = 1), linear sRGB (D65)
constants.note: Luminance Y = 0.294.

constants.label: Image tint at h = 1 (multiplier on linen, D65)
New linen reflectance at 550 nm
constants.note: Density 0.24 relative to the cloth.

constants.label: New linen, linear sRGB
constants.note: Spectral shape not in JJE; base slope assumed halved. Replace with a measured modern flax reference.

constants.label: Blood luminance Y
constants.note: Placeholder: keep the v2 chromaticity (G about equal to B, desaturated crimson-mauve) until the Schwalbe-Pellicori xy and the Gilbert dense-blood curve are pulled.

constants.label: Half-tone f_max
constants.note: Coloured fibril fraction f = h * f_max; each coloured fibril takes the JJE colour at h = 1/f_max, so the average equals the smooth model.

constants.label: Frontal intensity-distance range
constants.note: Image intensity falls monotonically to background over about 3.7 cm of vertical cloth-body distance.

constants.label: Linear fit r^2
constants.note: 13 points. The PRD notes a refit of JJE Fig. 2 gives 0.58.

constants.label: Residual sigma of the linear fit
Exponential alternative
constants.note: A labelled alternative curve shape from Shader of the Shroud v3; z0 chosen so z = 3.7 cm at h = 0.01, not fitted.

constants.label: Dorsal intensity-distance range
constants.note: No measured value exists. Fazio and Mandaglio 2008 find a steeper dorsal slope but call its range arbitrary. 0.037 is a placeholder until a fit exists.

constants.label: Dorsal/frontal contact pressure ratio with equal image amplitude
constants.note: 26.8 versus 0.35 g/cm^2. The mechanism is pressure-independent.

constants.label: Image encodes vertical cloth-body distance
constants.note: JJE's reading; the image-formation lab exists to test it against draping (Ercoline 1982).

constants.label: Relief exaggeration in the X3D relief scene
constants.note: Displayed relief = 0.037 m x h x exaggeration. 1 is true scale.

constants.label: Image not discernible closer than
constants.note: About 180 cm under photographic lighting (observers).

constants.label: Dissolve model
constants.value: CSF-weighted band contrast of h at the viewing distance (Mannos-Sakrison CSF, Peli band contrast), calibrated so detection crosses 50 % at 1.8 m
constants.note: This package's model of why the image dissolves; only the 1.8 m point is measured. See data/perception.json.

constants.label: Image to weave spectral power ratio
constants.note: From the v1/v2 slide FFT; a relative quantity that survives the v3 corrections. It is the frequency separation the LOD split relies on.

constants.label: Finest image detail
constants.note: Never synthesise image detail finer than 5 mm; the thread scale carries only weave.

constants.label: Cloth attenuation (Beer-Lambert)
constants.note: Uses the 345 um thickness.

constants.label: Subsurface radius (R, G, B)
constants.note: Approximation until fitted by inverse rendering.

constants.label: Transmitted light
constants.value: T = exp(-(mu_cloth + mu_blood*blood + mu_scorch*scorch)*d), no image term
constants.note: The 200 nm image layer cannot change bulk transmission; scorches attenuate through the full thickness; blood is near-opaque.

constants.label: Blood attenuation (green)
constants.note: Order of magnitude only (5 um layer assumption): blood is about opaque at fibre scale.

constants.label: Image coloration thickness
constants.note: Confined to the primary cell wall of the outermost fibrils; Pellicori 2025 proposes pectin/primary-wall chemistry.

constants.label: Double superficiality
constants.value: frontal face and hands faintly on the reverse; dorsal none

constants.label: Qualitative background emission hue
constants.note: Until the Schwalbe-Pellicori fluorescence xy clusters are pulled.

constants.label: Serum ring width (one slide-3 stain)
constants.note: Per-stain parameter; from the v1/v2 slide analysis (relative geometry survives).

constants.label: Blood findings
constants.value: hemoglobin/porphyrin, bilirubin, albumin; no image under blood

constants.label: AB blood typing
constants.note: Degraded samples can false-type AB.

constants.label: R/G discriminator (blood, image, linen)
constants.note: From the v1/v2 slides; verify on corrected data.
